{{verse|chapter=7|verse=25}} Certaine therfore of Hieru{{ls}}alem {{ls}}aid, Is not this he vvhom they {{ls}}eeke to kil? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=26}} And behold, he {{ls}}peaketh openly, and they {{ls}}ay nothing to him. Haue the Princes knovven in deede that this is {{sc|Christ}}? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=27}} But this man vve knovv whence he is. But vvhen {{sc|Christ}} commeth, no man knovveth vvhence he is. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=28}} {{sc|Iesvs}} therfore cried in the temple teaching, and {{ls}}aying, Both me you doe knovv, and vvhence I am you knovv.
